main_text.l: Ex triplici Targum, seu Chaldaica Paraphrasi, nempe Onkelos, Hierosolymitana, & Jonathanis, itemque R. Salomonis, & Aben Ezræ, aliisque Hebræis, perpetuo fere ordine excerptæ, unà cum Hebraicis Vocibus, nomen [?] Verbo nomen Graecorum [?] Symmachi, & Theodotionis, Hebraicæ Lectione passim expositæ, observationibus [?] cum Hebraeo textu conciliantur, vel ab eo discrepantia diluuntur.
Typis Guil. Du Gard, Impensis Sam. Thompson, Bibliopolæ Regii, cum Privilegio.

page.notes: Scan is very dark and blurred; many words in the subtitle and imprint block are illegible or doubtful and are marked [?] where a guess was made.
